Perfect! I've added a comprehensive column mapping reference to the top of your `mappings.json` file. The new section includes:

This makes it much easier to:
- Quickly see which Excel columns are being used
- Understand what data goes into each column
- Debug mapping issues
- Add new mappings in the future
